descFull: Reduce context size by 90%+ *and* make your agent smarter. Antigravity Context Mode is a local-first plugin built specifically for the Google Antigravity App. It prevents terminal commands, build logs, and multi-megabyte files from flooding your conversation history, saving thousands of tokens per turn and stopping "agent amnesia" in its tracks.
